the scorecard of a contractor and the log of its violations over HTTP (ST-CTR-014, AC-ST-CTR-014-1, AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-17) the evaluation (AC-ST-CTR-014-1, UAT-AC315) AC-ST-CTR-014-1 UAT-AC315: weights 80/70/90/60/100 into 80.50 and GOOD, refuses the author as approver, and the leader approves

the scorecard of a contractor and the log of its violations over HTTP (ST-CTR-014, AC-ST-CTR-014-1, AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-17) the evaluation (AC-ST-CTR-014-1, UAT-AC315) is 409 EVALUATION_DUPLICATE while one waits for the same kind and period, and a new revision once it is approved: approving it supersedes the first

the scorecard of a contractor and the log of its violations over HTTP (ST-CTR-014, AC-ST-CTR-014-1, AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-17) the evaluation (AC-ST-CTR-014-1, UAT-AC315) refuses an approval that is stale or of one that was approved already, and one by someone who may not approve

the scorecard of a contractor and the log of its violations over HTTP (ST-CTR-014, AC-ST-CTR-014-1, AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-17) the evaluation (AC-ST-CTR-014-1, UAT-AC315) judges the kind of evaluation by the contract: a completion one on an active contract, and any one on a draft, are 409 CONTRACT_STATE_INVALID

the scorecard of a contractor and the log of its violations over HTTP (ST-CTR-014, AC-ST-CTR-014-1, AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-17) the evaluation (AC-ST-CTR-014-1, UAT-AC315) refuses what is not an evaluation: scores out of the range, a kind it does not know, a period that is empty

the scorecard of a contractor and the log of its violations over HTTP (ST-CTR-014, AC-ST-CTR-014-1, AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-17) the evaluation (AC-ST-CTR-014-1, UAT-AC315) is the scope of the permission that decides: no right is 403, a contract that cannot be read is 404, and one that is read but not evaluated is 403 SCOPE_DENIED

the scorecard of a contractor and the log of its violations over HTTP (ST-CTR-014, AC-ST-CTR-014-1, AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-17) the violation (AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-PLAN-17) AC-ST-CTR-014-2 UAT-PLAN-17: a sanction is not confirmed without the document that decides it, and with it the violation is CONFIRMED and in the scorecard

the scorecard of a contractor and the log of its violations over HTTP (ST-CTR-014, AC-ST-CTR-014-1, AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-17) the violation (AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-PLAN-17) confirms a violation with no sanction without a document, once, and not by the one who recorded it

the scorecard of a contractor and the log of its violations over HTTP (ST-CTR-014, AC-ST-CTR-014-1, AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-17) the violation (AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-PLAN-17) takes the document that a violation was recorded with: a suggestion that a termination made rests on its document and is confirmed with it

the scorecard of a contractor and the log of its violations over HTTP (ST-CTR-014, AC-ST-CTR-014-1, AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-17) the violation (AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-PLAN-17) refuses what is not a violation: a day to come, a kind it does not know, an evidence that is not clean, a source with no record

the scorecard of a contractor and the log of its violations over HTTP (ST-CTR-014, AC-ST-CTR-014-1, AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-17) the violation (AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-PLAN-17) is the scope that decides: no right is 403, a contract that cannot be read is 404, one that is read but not recorded on is 403 SCOPE_DENIED

the scorecard of a contractor and the log of its violations over HTTP (ST-CTR-014, AC-ST-CTR-014-1, AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-17) the scorecard (CTR-23) lists the contracts, the evaluations with their weights and the log, and what the caller may do on each

the scorecard of a contractor and the log of its violations over HTTP (ST-CTR-014, AC-ST-CTR-014-1, AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-17) the scorecard (CTR-23) averages the approved evaluations that stand, to the hundredth, and counts the confirmed violations by severity

the scorecard of a contractor and the log of its violations over HTTP (ST-CTR-014, AC-ST-CTR-014-1, AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-17) the scorecard (CTR-23) counts the summary over everything in scope, not over the rows the lists hold: more than 500 approved evaluations are all in the count and the average

the scorecard of a contractor and the log of its violations over HTTP (ST-CTR-014, AC-ST-CTR-014-1, AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-17) the scorecard (CTR-23) lists the contractors that hold a contract the caller reads, by the permission of the scorecard alone: one who reads over another project sees the contractors of that project, a guest and a stranger see none

the scorecard of a contractor and the log of its violations over HTTP (ST-CTR-014, AC-ST-CTR-014-1, AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-17) the scorecard (CTR-23) limits the evaluations by the day they were made and the violations by the day they happened

the scorecard of a contractor and the log of its violations over HTTP (ST-CTR-014, AC-ST-CTR-014-1, AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-17) the scorecard (CTR-23) does not tell who a contractor is to one who reads none of its contracts: it is 404, and the name never leaves

the scorecard of a contractor and the log of its violations over HTTP (ST-CTR-014, AC-ST-CTR-014-1, AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-17) the scorecard (CTR-23) shows only the contracts the caller reads, never to a guest contractor, to a stranger, or across tenants

the scorecard of a contractor and the log of its violations over HTTP (ST-CTR-014, AC-ST-CTR-014-1, AC-ST-CTR-014-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-17) what the table keeps does not let what an evaluation says or what a violation says change, and never deletes either
the export of the records of the contractors over HTTP (ST-CTR-015, AC-ST-CTR-015-1, AC-ST-CTR-015-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-18) is registered in the module of CTR

the export of the records of the contractors over HTTP (ST-CTR-015, AC-ST-CTR-015-1, AC-ST-CTR-015-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-18) AC-ST-CTR-015-1 UAT-AC315: a period with nothing in it is 422 EXPORT_EMPTY and makes no batch; the records are not exported before they are approved or confirmed

the export of the records of the contractors over HTTP (ST-CTR-015, AC-ST-CTR-015-1, AC-ST-CTR-015-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-18) with an approved evaluation and a confirmed violation in the period AC-ST-CTR-015-1 UAT-AC315: the second run with the same parameters returns the same batch and the same hash, and only the approved and the confirmed rows are in the file

the export of the records of the contractors over HTTP (ST-CTR-015, AC-ST-CTR-015-1, AC-ST-CTR-015-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-18) with an approved evaluation and a confirmed violation in the period keeps the scopes and the formats apart: performance alone, violations alone and JSON are batches of their own, each with its own kind of row

the export of the records of the contractors over HTTP (ST-CTR-015, AC-ST-CTR-015-1, AC-ST-CTR-015-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-18) with an approved evaluation and a confirmed violation in the period exports only the contracts the caller holds the permission over: one scoped to another project gets that project, a stranger none, and a period that is backwards or too long is refused

the export of the records of the contractors over HTTP (ST-CTR-015, AC-ST-CTR-015-1, AC-ST-CTR-015-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-18) with an approved evaluation and a confirmed violation in the period hands a file to its maker and to whoever holds the permission over the whole tenant, never to a caller with a narrower scope, and not across tenants

the export of the records of the contractors over HTTP (ST-CTR-015, AC-ST-CTR-015-1, AC-ST-CTR-015-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-18) with an approved evaluation and a confirmed violation in the period gives the batch to everyone who asks for the same records, and writes a receipt only for one who may read the batch: a stranger of another project cannot mark it, a caller over the whole tenant can

the export of the records of the contractors over HTTP (ST-CTR-015, AC-ST-CTR-015-1, AC-ST-CTR-015-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-18) with an approved evaluation and a confirmed violation in the period revalidates the scope each time: someone who asked for a file of the whole tenant and was narrowed since no longer lists, downloads or marks it

the export of the records of the contractors over HTTP (ST-CTR-015, AC-ST-CTR-015-1, AC-ST-CTR-015-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-18) with an approved evaluation and a confirmed violation in the period stores the file once, named by its hash: the same records asked for again, or by someone else, are one object and no copy is left

the export of the records of the contractors over HTTP (ST-CTR-015, AC-ST-CTR-015-1, AC-ST-CTR-015-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-18) with an approved evaluation and a confirmed violation in the period serves the file for a signed link only: a link that was altered, or that names another file, is 401 SIGNATURE_INVALID

the export of the records of the contractors over HTTP (ST-CTR-015, AC-ST-CTR-015-1, AC-ST-CTR-015-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-18) with an approved evaluation and a confirmed violation in the period AC-ST-CTR-015-2 UAT-PLAN-18: writes down the receipt of a submission by hand once, and the list says the adapter is PROPOSED and its API MISSING

the export of the records of the contractors over HTTP (ST-CTR-015, AC-ST-CTR-015-1, AC-ST-CTR-015-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-18) with an approved evaluation and a confirmed violation in the period refuses a receipt that is not one: none, one that is too long, a day to come; one for a batch that is not there or is another tenant's, or by one with no right

the export of the records of the contractors over HTTP (ST-CTR-015, AC-ST-CTR-015-1, AC-ST-CTR-015-2, UAT-AC315, UAT-PLAN-18) with an approved evaluation and a confirmed violation in the period does not let a batch change, or a receipt change, or either be deleted
